idle.intro: Signing in with an admin account automatically registers a collection Entra app for this tenant and starts admin consent.
idle.hint: ME3 tenants require a browser sign-in to download eDiscovery exports. Registering an account here enables automatic download with no sign-in prompt. You can also add it later in Settings.

running.deviceCodeIntro: Enter the code below, sign in as an admin, and complete the consent prompt.

errors.consent-denied: Admin consent was denied, or app registration may not have propagated yet. Please wait a moment and press “Retry”. On the consent screen you must click “Accept”, and you must be a Global Administrator.
errors.consent-access_denied: Admin consent was denied. Please sign in as a Global Administrator and click “Accept” on the consent screen.
errors.consent-timeout: The consent wait time (5 minutes) has expired. Please try again.
errors.consent-state-mismatch: Security verification (state) failed. Please try again.
